name: Stripe
description: Bounded typed Stripe customers, payments, refunds, subscriptions, invoices, reconciliation, Connect transfers, payouts and disputes with explicit write confirmation.

permissions.description: Fixed api.stripe.com HTTPS only, using an externally supplied secret/restricted key. Explicit confirmation on every mutation and financial action; caller-owned idempotency for POST. No SDK, ambient credential discovery, webhooks or automatic retry. Event ingress requires explicit administrator profiles, saved secret references and provider/relay setup. Installation never provisions subscriptions or executes trigger code.

definitions.name: Stripe Get Customer (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/customers/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.name: Stripe List Customer (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/customers, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. Sources: https://docs.stripe.com/api/versioning https://docs.stripe.com/api/idempotent_requests https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/openapi/master/openapi/spec3.json https://docs.stripe.com/api/customers https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents https://docs.stripe.com/api/charges https://docs.stripe.com/api/refunds https://docs.stripe.com/api/setup_intents https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_methods https://docs.stripe.com/api/products https://docs.stripe.com/api/prices https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoiceitems https://docs.stripe.com/api/balance https://docs.stripe.com/api/balance_transactions https://docs.stripe.com/api/transfers https://docs.stripe.com/api/transfer_reversals https://docs.stripe.com/api/payouts https://docs.stripe.com/api/disputes

definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/customers, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/customers/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. One DELETE https://api.stripe.com/v1/customers/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.name: Stripe Get Payment Intent (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/payment_intents/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.name: Stripe List Payment Intent (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/payment_intents, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/payment_intents, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/payment_intents/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/payment_intents/:id/confirm, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.name: Stripe Capture Payment Intent (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/payment_intents/:id/capture, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/payment_intents/:id/cancel, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.name: Stripe Get Charge (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/charges/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.name: Stripe List Charge (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/charges, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. Sources: https://docs.stripe.com/api/versioning https://docs.stripe.com/api/idempotent_requests https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/openapi/master/openapi/spec3.json https://docs.stripe.com/api/customers https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents https://docs.stripe.com/api/charges https://docs.stripe.com/api/refunds https://docs.stripe.com/api/setup_intents https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_methods https://docs.stripe.com/api/products https://docs.stripe.com/api/prices https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoiceitems https://docs.stripe.com/api/balance https://docs.stripe.com/api/balance_transactions https://docs.stripe.com/api/transfers https://docs.stripe.com/api/transfer_reversals https://docs.stripe.com/api/payouts https://docs.stripe.com/api/disputes

definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/charges/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/charges/:id/capture, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/refunds/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.name: Stripe List Refund (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/refunds, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/refunds, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/refunds/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.name: Stripe Cancel Refund (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/refunds/:id/cancel, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. definitions.name: Stripe Get Setup Intent (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/setup_intents/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. definitions.documentation:
One GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/setup_intents, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.name: Stripe Create Setup Intent (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/setup_intents, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/setup_intents/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/setup_intents/:id/confirm, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/setup_intents/:id/cancel, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. definitions.name: Stripe Get Payment Method (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/payment_methods/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/payment_methods/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/payment_methods/:id/attach, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/payment_methods/:id/detach, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.name: Stripe Get Product (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/products/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. Sources: https://docs.stripe.com/api/versioning https://docs.stripe.com/api/idempotent_requests https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/openapi/master/openapi/spec3.json https://docs.stripe.com/api/customers https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents https://docs.stripe.com/api/charges https://docs.stripe.com/api/refunds https://docs.stripe.com/api/setup_intents https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_methods https://docs.stripe.com/api/products https://docs.stripe.com/api/prices https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoiceitems https://docs.stripe.com/api/balance https://docs.stripe.com/api/balance_transactions https://docs.stripe.com/api/transfers https://docs.stripe.com/api/transfer_reversals https://docs.stripe.com/api/payouts https://docs.stripe.com/api/disputes

definitions.name: Stripe List Product (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/products, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/products, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. definitions.documentation:
One DELETE https://api.stripe.com/v1/products/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.name: Stripe Get Price (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/prices/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.name: Stripe List Price (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/prices, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. Sources: https://docs.stripe.com/api/versioning https://docs.stripe.com/api/idempotent_requests https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/openapi/master/openapi/spec3.json https://docs.stripe.com/api/customers https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents https://docs.stripe.com/api/charges https://docs.stripe.com/api/refunds https://docs.stripe.com/api/setup_intents https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_methods https://docs.stripe.com/api/products https://docs.stripe.com/api/prices https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoiceitems https://docs.stripe.com/api/balance https://docs.stripe.com/api/balance_transactions https://docs.stripe.com/api/transfers https://docs.stripe.com/api/transfer_reversals https://docs.stripe.com/api/payouts https://docs.stripe.com/api/disputes

definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/prices, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/prices/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.name: Stripe Get Subscription (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/subscriptions/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.name: Stripe List Subscription (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/subscriptions, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. Sources: https://docs.stripe.com/api/versioning https://docs.stripe.com/api/idempotent_requests https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/openapi/master/openapi/spec3.json https://docs.stripe.com/api/customers https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents https://docs.stripe.com/api/charges https://docs.stripe.com/api/refunds https://docs.stripe.com/api/setup_intents https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_methods https://docs.stripe.com/api/products https://docs.stripe.com/api/prices https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoiceitems https://docs.stripe.com/api/balance https://docs.stripe.com/api/balance_transactions https://docs.stripe.com/api/transfers https://docs.stripe.com/api/transfer_reversals https://docs.stripe.com/api/payouts https://docs.stripe.com/api/disputes

definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/subscriptions, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/subscriptions/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. One DELETE https://api.stripe.com/v1/subscriptions/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.name: Stripe Resume Subscription (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/subscriptions/:id/resume, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoices/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof.
