definitions.documentation:
One GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoices, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.name: Stripe Create Invoice (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoices, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoices/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One DELETE https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoices/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoices/:id/finalize, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoices/:id/pay, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.name: Stripe send invoice (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoices/:id/send, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoices/:id/void, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoices/:id/mark_uncollectible, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoiceitems/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoiceitems, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoiceitems, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. Sources: https://docs.stripe.com/api/versioning https://docs.stripe.com/api/idempotent_requests https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/openapi/master/openapi/spec3.json https://docs.stripe.com/api/customers https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents https://docs.stripe.com/api/charges https://docs.stripe.com/api/refunds https://docs.stripe.com/api/setup_intents https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_methods https://docs.stripe.com/api/products https://docs.stripe.com/api/prices https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoiceitems https://docs.stripe.com/api/balance https://docs.stripe.com/api/balance_transactions https://docs.stripe.com/api/transfers https://docs.stripe.com/api/transfer_reversals https://docs.stripe.com/api/payouts https://docs.stripe.com/api/disputes

definitions.name: Stripe Delete Invoice Item (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One DELETE https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoiceitems/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/balance, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.name: Stripe Get Transfer (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/transfers/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. Sources: https://docs.stripe.com/api/versioning https://docs.stripe.com/api/idempotent_requests https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/openapi/master/openapi/spec3.json https://docs.stripe.com/api/customers https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents https://docs.stripe.com/api/charges https://docs.stripe.com/api/refunds https://docs.stripe.com/api/setup_intents https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_methods https://docs.stripe.com/api/products https://docs.stripe.com/api/prices https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoiceitems https://docs.stripe.com/api/balance https://docs.stripe.com/api/balance_transactions https://docs.stripe.com/api/transfers https://docs.stripe.com/api/transfer_reversals https://docs.stripe.com/api/payouts https://docs.stripe.com/api/disputes

definitions.name: Stripe List Transfer (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/transfers, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. Sources: https://docs.stripe.com/api/versioning https://docs.stripe.com/api/idempotent_requests https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/openapi/master/openapi/spec3.json https://docs.stripe.com/api/customers https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents https://docs.stripe.com/api/charges https://docs.stripe.com/api/refunds https://docs.stripe.com/api/setup_intents https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_methods https://docs.stripe.com/api/products https://docs.stripe.com/api/prices https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoiceitems https://docs.stripe.com/api/balance https://docs.stripe.com/api/balance_transactions https://docs.stripe.com/api/transfers https://docs.stripe.com/api/transfer_reversals https://docs.stripe.com/api/payouts https://docs.stripe.com/api/disputes

definitions.name: Stripe Create Connect Transfer (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/transfers, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. Sources: https://docs.stripe.com/api/versioning https://docs.stripe.com/api/idempotent_requests https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/openapi/master/openapi/spec3.json https://docs.stripe.com/api/customers https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents https://docs.stripe.com/api/charges https://docs.stripe.com/api/refunds https://docs.stripe.com/api/setup_intents https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_methods https://docs.stripe.com/api/products https://docs.stripe.com/api/prices https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoiceitems https://docs.stripe.com/api/balance https://docs.stripe.com/api/balance_transactions https://docs.stripe.com/api/transfers https://docs.stripe.com/api/transfer_reversals https://docs.stripe.com/api/payouts https://docs.stripe.com/api/disputes

definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/transfers/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.name: Stripe Get Transfer Reversal (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/transfers/:transfer/reversals/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/transfers/:transfer/reversals, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/transfers/:transfer/reversals, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/transfers/:transfer/reversals/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. Sources: https://docs.stripe.com/api/versioning https://docs.stripe.com/api/idempotent_requests https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/openapi/master/openapi/spec3.json https://docs.stripe.com/api/customers https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents https://docs.stripe.com/api/charges https://docs.stripe.com/api/refunds https://docs.stripe.com/api/setup_intents https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_methods https://docs.stripe.com/api/products https://docs.stripe.com/api/prices https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoiceitems https://docs.stripe.com/api/balance https://docs.stripe.com/api/balance_transactions https://docs.stripe.com/api/transfers https://docs.stripe.com/api/transfer_reversals https://docs.stripe.com/api/payouts https://docs.stripe.com/api/disputes

definitions.name: Stripe Get Payout (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/payouts/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/payouts, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. Sources: https://docs.stripe.com/api/versioning https://docs.stripe.com/api/idempotent_requests https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/openapi/master/openapi/spec3.json https://docs.stripe.com/api/customers https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents https://docs.stripe.com/api/charges https://docs.stripe.com/api/refunds https://docs.stripe.com/api/setup_intents https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_methods https://docs.stripe.com/api/products https://docs.stripe.com/api/prices https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoiceitems https://docs.stripe.com/api/balance https://docs.stripe.com/api/balance_transactions https://docs.stripe.com/api/transfers https://docs.stripe.com/api/transfer_reversals https://docs.stripe.com/api/payouts https://docs.stripe.com/api/disputes

definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/payouts, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/payouts/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. Sources: https://docs.stripe.com/api/versioning https://docs.stripe.com/api/idempotent_requests https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/openapi/master/openapi/spec3.json https://docs.stripe.com/api/customers https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents https://docs.stripe.com/api/charges https://docs.stripe.com/api/refunds https://docs.stripe.com/api/setup_intents https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_methods https://docs.stripe.com/api/products https://docs.stripe.com/api/prices https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoiceitems https://docs.stripe.com/api/balance https://docs.stripe.com/api/balance_transactions https://docs.stripe.com/api/transfers https://docs.stripe.com/api/transfer_reversals https://docs.stripe.com/api/payouts https://docs.stripe.com/api/disputes

definitions.name: Stripe Cancel Payout (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/payouts/:id/cancel, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.name: Stripe Reverse Payout (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/payouts/:id/reverse, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/disputes/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/disputes, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/disputes/:id, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. definitions.documentation:
One POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/disputes/:id/close, Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive. Externally supplied RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; connection.config merges with node config; secretName overrides the credential, stripeAccount explicitly selects an authorized Connect account. Request confirmMutation=true required. Request confirmFinancial=true required: this can move funds, change billing, send an invoice or accept a dispute loss. Required caller-owned idempotencyKey (1–255 printable ASCII); reconcile uncertain results before intentional retry. Numeric $retries=0 only; no automatic replay, retry, pagination or redirect. Form/query serialization uses bracketed object keys and indexed arrays, preserving false/zero; null and empty collections encode as an empty form value for supported clearable fields. Only declared parameters accepted. Returned values are a typed selected-field projection: client secrets, bank/account numbers, raw provider errors, evidence files and unknown fields are omitted. Lists expose data/has_more/url, never follow url automatically. Amounts are integer smallest currency units, not floating point major units. Total 100–30000ms deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards streaming, decoding and final cleanup. 256KiB request/form; 1MiB response; 100 rows, depth30, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty fragments. Native worker fetch/AbortController/TextDecoder/URLSearchParams only; no SDK install. Requires provider permissions, region/payment method/state/Connect capabilities. No payment method creation/raw card data, SCA browser action, webhook trigger/signature verification, OAuth/refresh, file upload, tax automation or provider-live proof. Plain raw-body HMAC-SHA256 cannot verify Stripe. Mapping: Map event.id/type/created/account and data.object into the declared group; timestamps become exact UTC millisecond ISO. Amounts remain canonical decimal strings in Stripe minor units and currency remains provider currency code. Do not include payment method details or customer contact data. Canonical eventType values: customer.subscription.created, customer.subscription.updated, customer.subscription.deleted. Required envelope: version=1, provider=stripe, deliveryId, eventType, occurredAt (UTC ISO milliseconds), accountId, resource as the typed output schema. Omit no required fields; use explicit null where allowed. Filters accountId/resourceId are exact matches; blank disables a filter. At most 100 account+delivery IDs within 96 KiB deduplicate retries per group; state commits on trigger success before downstream completion. Out-of-order events and retries occur; retrieve authoritative resources separately when needed. Relay is required for timestamp-prefixed Stripe signature validation. Sources: https://docs.stripe.com/webhooks https://docs.stripe.com/events/manage-webhook-endpoints

Saved entry setup: explicitly select webhook mode, configure the inspector fields, select a profile belonging to this exact installed package requirement, and save the node. Package metadata does not infer entry mode or provision/bind a profile. Enable workflow and entry only after deliberate setup.

ingressRequirements.name: Stripe business events relay
ingressRequirements.description: Manual prerequisite: separately maintained exact provider authentication/normalization relay. This release only accepts header-authenticated canonical envelopes from that relay.
setupSteps: Install this reviewed package release; no relay or subscription is installed.
Deploy an independently maintained provider-aware relay which implements the exact provider signature, challenge, authorization and replay rules described below.

Verify Stripe-Signature using the official SDK against exact raw body and endpoint signing secret, signed timestamp and bounded replay tolerance; authorize expected account and live/test mode. Plain raw-body HMAC-SHA256 cannot verify Stripe.

Map event.id/type/created/account and data.object into the declared group; timestamps become exact UTC millisecond ISO. Amounts remain canonical decimal strings in Stripe minor units and currency remains provider currency code. Do not include payment method details or customer contact data.

Implement the exact canonical version-1 envelope and typed resource schemas documented by each selected trigger; forward one event per POST. Normalize account identity from the authorized provider connection, never from an untrusted request.

Persist one stable delivery ID per logical event across relay retries. Fanout IDs must include distinct native entity/event/status identity (or a persisted record ID); reusing a batch delivery ID or message ID across different statuses drops events. Authorize account/resources; bound payloads to 64 KiB and limit rate.
Save a separate relay-to-ONF callback secret; create a header-authenticated ingress profile for this requirement.
Bind the intended trigger node, configure the relay with its HTTPS callback URL, then deliberately enable workflow and entry.
Review relay limits, delivery identifiers, retries and downstream idempotency; test explicitly before production use.

Select saved node entry mode webhook explicitly; package metadata does not infer it. Create/select a profile for this exact installed requirement (installation.id + "/verified-events"), bind node.trigger.ingress.profileId, save the graph and deliberately enable workflow and entry only when setup is complete.

network.purpose: Provider HTTPS callbacks reach the independently deployed relay; ONF uses its existing HTTPS publication.
